It's the time when things slow down, or stop working altogether and when you need to speak with a friendly face you pick up a phone to see your doctor.  Sadly, this option is no longer available. Whereas last year I could book an appointment for next week now they will only see you on the same day which you have to phone to book at 8am.  I've tried this on many occasions; finding myself number 14 in the queue, or sometimes pressing 1 on the keypad to have them call back when you reach the top, but to no avail.  Appointments are usually all gone by 8.20am so they tell you to call again tomorrow, or you can book on their online system EVERGREEN (don't get me started on that - laughs out loud!). Most times I dutifully follow orders, but sometimes I will be sneaky and try calling them at 7.55am to jump the queue, but it simply says that the surgery is closed and will open at 8am...

In the past when the system was 'broken' you had to wait two weeks to see a GP, but I would prefer this to not seeing a GP at all.
